This notebook builds the platform image and tests the platform contract.

Do not mount `/work`. Do not activate a project Spack environment yet. Do not run `rv sync`, `quarto check`, or VS Code tunnel commands yet. These actions will obfuscate your ability
to validate the platform.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
from spython.main import Client
from rse_workbench.helpers import spython_exec, show_spython
```

The following code may take some time as it runs in the foreground:

```{python}
Client.build(
    image=str(project_contract.build_image),
    recipe=str(project_contract.singularity_def),
    options=["--fakeroot", "--sandbox", "--fix-perms", "--force"],
    sudo=False,
)
```

## Platform-only validation

If the installables in the previous notebook are correct,
the platform image should pass the following tests.
Feel free to add more if you need!

```{python}
show_spython(
    spython_exec(
        command=r'''
set -euo pipefail

echo "PATH=$PATH"
which spack
which python3
which rv
which uv
which code
which quarto

spack --version
python3 --version
rv --version
uv --version
code --version
quarto --version
''',
        image=project_contract.build_image,
        options=["--no-home"],
    ),
    tail=120,
)
```

Expected result:

```text
spack works
python3 works
rv works
uv works
code works
quarto works
```

Note that the above tests are just for the platform; they are
not expected to be carried over to the final image — that will
be tested independently.
